IBM/MSFT/AMZN are partial credit: genuine quantum programs but not pure-plays. MSFT and AMZN overlap with direct holdings (minor — different thesis rationale). AUM $219M and WisdomTree brand quality provide ample liquidity. Committee already approved INITIATE at 2.0% — this analysis confirms that decision. YTD +52% and price 8.6% below 52w high means start with 1.0% now, add remaining 1.0% on any pullback to $32-34 range.

### Upside Catalysts

- Any major pure-play quantum company (IONQ, QBTS) announces commercial advantage milestone — basket re-rates
- DARPA/DoD funding increase for quantum programs (geopolitical driver)
- IBM or Google announces breakthrough in error correction — validates sector
- Post-quantum cryptography enterprise demand accelerates quantum hardware adoption
- WisdomTree fund inflows accelerate on sector momentum — ETF premium creates liquidity

### Risks

- YTD +52% — entry near 52w high; a risk-off rotation or single-name disappointment compresses the basket
- Top 3 holdings (QBTS/RGTI/IONQ) all pre-profit with burn rates; capital markets stress could force dilutive raises
- Remaining 60% of AUM is unknown from yfinance — could include less-aligned names
- MSFT and AMZN overlap with existing direct positions (IBM, Microsoft already held via GOOG adjacency)
- Expense ratio ~0.45% (WisdomTree estimate) — low drag but present
- Fund is 10+ months old — limited track record for a sector ETF at this stage

### Entry Note

INITIATE in two tranches: 1.0% immediately at market open (overnight session or Monday open), remaining 1.0% on pullback to $32-34 range (10-15% from current). Total target 2.0% per committee decision. Do not chase if it gaps above $40 — wait for the pullback.
